# EctoEmail v3.0.4 - Table of Contents

An Ecto.Type for email address fields

## Pages

- [LICENSE](https://ecto-email.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [EctoEmail](https://ecto-email.hexdocs.pm/EctoEmail.md): An `Ecto.Type` for email addresses, using the
[`ex_email`](https://github.com/synchronal/ex_email) library
for validations.
